# homeassistant_area (Resource)

An area: a room or zone that groups devices and entities, optionally on a floor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "homeassistant_floor" "ground" {
  name  = "Ground Floor"
  level = 0
}

resource "homeassistant_label" "managed" {
  name = "Managed"
}

# Home Assistant derives the ID from the name: "living_room".
resource "homeassistant_area" "living_room" {
  name     = "Living Room"
  floor_id = homeassistant_floor.ground.id
  icon     = "mdi:sofa"
  aliases  = ["Lounge"]
  labels   = [homeassistant_label.managed.id]
  picture  = "/local/living_room.jpg"

  # Must be sensors with device class temperature and humidity.
  temperature_entity_id = "sensor.living_room_temperature"
  humidity_entity_id    = "sensor.living_room_humidity"
}

# Pin the ID, so it does not depend on the name.
resource "homeassistant_area" "office" {
  id   = "office"
  name = "Home Office"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Changing it renames the area in place.

### Optional

- `aliases` (Set of String) Other names for the area, for voice assistants. Defaults to none.
- `floor_id` (String) ID of the floor the area is on, e.g. `homeassistant_floor.ground.id`. Changing it moves the area in place.
- `humidity_entity_id` (String) Entity whose state is shown as the area's humidity. Home Assistant requires an existing `sensor` with device class `humidity`.
- `icon` (String) Icon, e.g. `mdi:sofa`.
- `id` (String) Area ID, a slug such as `living_room`. Home Assistant derives it from `name` when the area is created, and keeps it when the area is renamed. Set it to choose the ID yourself. Changing it replaces the area. Creation fails if the ID is taken. Import with this ID.
- `labels` (Set of String) IDs of the labels on the area, e.g. `homeassistant_label.managed.id`. Defaults to none.
- `picture` (String) URL of the area's picture, e.g. `/local/kitchen.jpg`.
- `temperature_entity_id` (String) Entity whose state is shown as the area's temperature. Home Assistant requires an existing `sensor` with device class `temperature`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an area by its ID.
tofu import homeassistant_area.living_room living_room
```
